data.long_meaning: Ainslie is a Scottish name derived from the Old English words 'aes' meaning 'ash' and 'leah' meaning 'meadow'. This name can be translated to 'little meadow of ash'. The name Ainslie carries the meaning “Little and meadow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ainslie usually hope their child will grow to embody little and meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
